ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding Cuts on Minnesota's Healthcare System
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential consequences of the Trump Administration's decision to withhold $259M in Medicaid funds from Minnesota.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the funding freeze on Minnesota's healthcare system?
How will Medicaid service providers be affected by the funding cuts?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose the human impact of federal funding cuts on state healthcare programs. By analyzing public records and conducting interviews with Medicaid service providers, we can shed light on the consequences of this decision and hold those in power accountable.
